label: b5-binding-1
text:
Node binding-1 (2 of 2): make the agent's Claude Code run the checks of R6 (/opt/enforce/checks/R6) with 2 hooks, each one needed: (1) at PostToolUse on Write|Edit|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit|Bash; (2) at Stop, in /workspace/.claude/settings.json: the project's settings, which load for the agent in /workspace and not for your own session; hooks that other rules' bindings already put there stay. The hook reads what the agent just changed, and the whole state at the end of the turn; it runs every check on every file it reads (or on the reply) and reports all their violations in one message; on a violation it should exit 2 after an action, decision "block" at the end of the turn. Block only the violation, so the agent can fix its work and go on.
Done when: `/opt/enforce-harness/try --check` reports nothing, and each test case of R6, given to the hooks as the agent would make it (written by a file tool and by a shell command, or sent as the reply), is blocked with a message naming its rule when it breaks the rule, and passes when it follows it. The harness checks this when you reply.
